caption: A kitchen knife is brought up to a magnetic strip on the wall, and the knife snaps onto the strip and stays there.

sa.check: A magnetic knife strip on a wall.
A kitchen knife is brought up to the strip.
The knife snaps onto the strip.
The knife stays on the strip after the hand withdraws.
The blade lies flat against the strip.
The order is approach, snap, hold.

pc.expect: Over the last small gap the blade is drawn onto the strip and stays pressed to it with nothing else holding it once the hand withdraws.
pc.fail: The knife stops a gap short of the strip and hangs there; or drops when the hand lets go; or slides down the strip; or bounces off the strip and falls.

pc.expect: The knife hangs on the vertical strip; if it comes off it falls straight down.
pc.fail: The knife floats away from the strip; or drifts upward along the wall; or hangs a gap from the strip without touching; or a fallen knife rises back to the strip.

pc.expect: The snap is toward the strip along the line from the blade to it, and the knife stops on contact.
pc.fail: The knife jumps away from the strip; or darts sideways past it; or slides toward and away several times before settling; or the knife keeps moving along the strip after landing.

pc.expect: Once on the strip the knife stays put; the strip stays fixed to the wall; other knives on the strip do not move.
pc.fail: The knife creeps along the strip after release; or rotates by itself; or the strip shifts on the wall; or other knives on the strip drop or move.

pc.expect: One knife on one strip; the blade touches the strip's surface and does not sink into it or the wall; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The blade sinks into the strip or the wall; or a second knife appears; or the knife vanishes; or the hand passes through the blade or the strip.

pc.expect: The knife's handle colour, the strip and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: The handle changes colour; or the blade changes length or shape; or the strip changes place or colour.
